# ADR-041 — Daily Brief is manual/on-demand only — no queue, no cron, no scheduled or autonomous agents

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

The Personal OS Daily Brief is **manual/on-demand only**: deterministic bounded collector → single provider-agnostic LLM call through the existing `ai_task_routes` layer (`task_name='daily_brief'`) with an explicit abort timeout, output-token cap, injection-guarded prompt, structured graceful degradation when no provider is configured, and persistence unique per `(brief_date, timezone)`. **No queue, no cron, no scheduled or autonomous agents** in Phase 5. Production provider/model registration is deferred to the gated deployment checkpoint (user-approved 2026-08-21)
